directionPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: professional original CHARACTER DESIGN direction board for Crystal Path, a premium mobile crystal-path game. Create FOUR striking, memorable original game mascots in a clean 2x2 composition, each shown full body, one per quadrant with generous space. NO WORDS, labels, logos, numbers or UI. All four belong to one DISTINCTIVE visual language: angular cut-paper silhouettes rendered as premium tactile 2.5D sculptures, a few bold ink-like contour cuts, matte surfaces contrasted with precise translucent crystal seams, controlled hard/soft edges, strong asymmetric silhouettes, cinematic side lighting, restrained grain. Capable, mischievous, adventurous and a little badass. Avoid the generic plush baby mascot look: NO enormous wet baby eyes, huge spherical heads, glossy candy rendering, timid cutesy poses, stock fantasy costumes or familiar franchise designs. No weapons, injury or threatening expressions. Family-friendly confidence.

TOP LEFT, MICA, woodland collectible creature: compact bipedal geode beast with charcoal basalt body and jade crystal armor grown into one shoulder. One LARGE asymmetric crescent-shaped geode ear and one short blunt stone ear, three smooth amber seed stones on the brow, sturdy short feet, two small expressive almond-shaped luminous eyes and a clever half-smile. A diagonal OPEN CRYSTAL NOTCH in the chest is the signature negative-space detail. Looks like a little living ancient rock sanctuary, not a fox, mouse or dragon from an existing franchise.

TOP RIGHT, RALLY, sports companion: a living folded racing pennant shaped into a compact athletic runner. Graphite and warm burnt-orange lacquered ribbon planes, a narrow angled cyan glass face with expressive eye slits, silver running shoes, an offset translucent crystal fin and one long folded ribbon forming a dynamic shoulder silhouette. Confident ready-to-sprint pose, hands loose, no armor helmet or brand clothing. The same diagonal open crystal notch appears as a chest fold.

BOTTOM LEFT, RIFF, puppy companion: a small scrappy charcoal-and-ivory TERRIER PUPPY, four paws, one upright ear and one folded ear, a warm copper patch around one eye, wiry short fur in sculptural graphic clumps, intelligent almond eyes, chin up, cheeky calm expression. Wears a beautifully designed compact burnt-orange rescue backpack/harness and an asymmetrical teal neckerchief, one tiny translucent crystal clasp with the open diagonal notch. A distinctive little courier and rooftop adventurer, still clearly a young dog and very lovable. Not a humanoid. No generic golden-retriever plush proportions.

BOTTOM RIGHT, NYX, kitten companion: a sleek small ink-black KITTEN, four paws, one white front paw, warm ivory muzzle, narrow curious amber eyes, a diagonal ivory crystal-shaped brow marking, long curled tail with an ivory paint-dipped tip. Wears a short asymmetric indigo fabric flight cape and one moonstone clasp with the same diagonal open notch. Crouches with quiet mischievous confidence as a moonlit rooftop explorer. No superhero mask, huge round baby face or cartoon franchise styling.

Plain muted dark slate studio backdrop behind each figure, no scenic environments or extra props. Carefully art-directed, bespoke silhouettes that remain recognizable in black-and-white at small mobile size. Make the material joins and asymmetry feel intentional, not random detail. This is a fresh original design exploration, not an edit of earlier cute drafts.

environmentPrompts.prompt:
Create a finished portrait 2:3 background-only environment plate for the premium original game Crystal Path. Reference board provides ONLY the angular matte sculptural art language and colors; do NOT include any characters. This environment must feel authored and distinctive, not generic fantasy wallpaper. Physical cut-paper/ink 2.5D sculpture, beautifully composed oversized asymmetrical silhouettes, tactile matte stone/enamel, a few translucent crystal cuts with the collection's diagonal open-notch motif. Cinematic soft side-light, restricted rich palette. IMPORTANT GAMEPLAY COMPOSITION: the ENTIRE central 60% width from top to bottom is an uninterrupted very quiet dark atmospheric gradient; detail and brighter lighting confined to outermost 20% side margins and top 12%. Bottom center also quiet and dark. No path, bridge, tiles, ground plane, stairs or objects under the imaginary central path, no central focal object, no text/logos/UI/borders, no people or creatures. Edge architecture fades into atmospheric depth, limited tiny highlights, no busy particles or star fields. Premium art direction, strong authored geometry, no photorealism, no cutesy cottages, no generic neon tunnel.
PRISMWILDS: geological wonder made of giant asymmetrical hollow basalt seed pods and jade geode arches suspended at side edges. One enormous broken crescent shell enters upper left, amber resin seams, sparse sharply folded fossil reeds on lower right, hovering squared slate tablets at edges. Moss/pine green and charcoal matte, sage jade glass interiors, tiny warm amber. Central negative space deep smoky green. Ancient botanical geology, not ordinary trees or a jungle.
